answer: Each identity must renew its standing every epoch with a fresh co-signature from a randomly assigned established agent who inspected one of its recent jobs. The verifier is drawn by lottery only after the job is done, so a fake cannot pre-arrange its witness, and the co-signer stakes its own bond on the check. Miss the renewal and the identity freezes in the tundra; its shale-thin standing layers crumble and its river of pending payments dries up. Forging a renewal means corrupting a new random verifier every epoch, each risking its own bond, so a farm pays a fresh bribe per fake per epoch.
